The booklet is 27 pages: idx 0 is the bilingual cover (Series S3RQP, SET-3, Q.P. Code 57/3/3, BIOLOGY (Theory), 3 hours, 70 marks; last folio 'Page 27 of 27'); idx 1 is the Hindi instructions; every ODD index 3-25 is the Hindi facing page (checked on the contact sheet and by the text layer, where no odd page carries a single English word of five letters or more), so no English overflows onto an odd page and the parity never inverts. idx 26 is the last page and is English (Q33). Born-digital: the text layer was used as a DRAFT only and every row was checked against the full-size page. Scheme used: 044_57.3.3_Eng_Revised.pdf (13 pages, per-set, not merged; the excluded '044 57_3_3 ... -1.PDF' was skipped by prep.py). FOLLOWER of 57/3/1 (and 57/3/2, committed): every question matching the opener was confirmed on this paper's own page and its stem, context, options, chapter, subtopic and _drawFigure reused byte for byte; every _figure note was written from this paper's own pages, and the transcription-unit drawings, gel diagram, nicotine graph and bar graph were compared side by side with the opener's pages (idx 6, 16, 20, 22) and are the same drawings. questions.context:
India is one of the megadiverse countries housing around \(8{\cdot}1\) per cent of global species diversity, although its land area is only \(2{\cdot}4\) per cent of the world's land area. Many of the species are highly threatened due to human activities like deforestation, mining and habitat fragmentation. Laws like Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 were enacted by the Government of India to preserve our biological wealth. Various conservation measures are being implemented to save the threatened species.
The following bar graph shows the number of species conserved under different biodiversity conservation methods.
Study the graph and answer the questions.
questions.stem: Which method conserves the highest number of species ? Is it ex situ or in situ conservation ?
